What I didn't know, and what most people still don't know is that depression manifests itself in a variety of ways. For me, it was (and sometimes still is) complete emotional numbness. I didn't feel sad because I didn't feel anything the majority of the time.

I was diagnosed with depression in January 2016, but I had been battling it for years without knowing what it was. I always assumed depression was a constant feeling of sadness and/or self-loathing. I hadn't ever felt those things, so I assumed I was fine.

(Thread) There's been a lot of tweets about depression and awareness today, and since this is a topic that directly affects me, I'm going to add a small (but hopefully meaningful to someone) contribution.
